description: Use official MicroG-RE 7.2.2 for Google Maps and synthesized navigation speech, start Google TTS before guidance, skip the uncertified-device screen and avoid a crash when a location-settings dialog cannot open. Includes an opt-in Picture-in-picture setting in Maps Settings and an opt-in native EV model experiment that sends BYD battery data and estimated road-load coefficients to Google. Arrival forecasts and navigation display remain experimental. Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.0 or newer.

patches.name: BYD native battery experiment
patches.description: Experimental: sends this BYD's battery and road-load model to Google through Maps' native EV route requests. Starts from the car's own average consumption, learns slowly from BMS energy/distance, and adds in-app vehicle settings. Native hooks inspected on Maps 26.41 and 26.42. Targets BYD DiLink 3; DiLink 5 unverified.

options.description: Experimental: shows an inline battery icon and Google's arrival percentage after ETA.

patches.name: BYD navigation audio routing
patches.description: Routes navigation prompts to the BYD-specific audio stream when supported, retaining the original fallback. Not needed on phones.

patches.name: Device certification fix
patches.description: Skips the uncertified-device screen that closes Maps on devices Google does not certify.

patches.name: Google Maps for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Connects supported Google Maps builds to MicroG-RE 7.2.2 and avoids a crash when a location-settings dialog cannot open.

patches.name: Navigation speech and TTS startup
patches.description: Prefers synthesized navigation speech, keeping the existing audio fallback, and starts Google TTS when Maps opens.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture setting
patches.description: Adds a Picture-in-picture On/Off setting to Maps Settings. Turn it off so navigation does not open a small window when you leave Maps; it starts on, as in Maps. Hooks inspected on Maps 26.41 and 26.42.

release_notes:
- Splits the single Maps patch into patches you can select separately (#22, thanks @sheepymeh):
  - **Google Maps for MicroG-RE** keeps MicroG-RE support and the location-settings crash fix.
  - **Device certification fix** and **Navigation speech and TTS startup** are on by default.
  - **BYD navigation audio routing** is now off by default. On a BYD head unit, turn it on when patching so navigation prompts keep using the BYD navigation audio stream.
- The patched code is unchanged. With all six patches selected, the patched app is identical to the 1.4.2 test build.
- Uses official MicroG-RE 7.2.2.
- Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.0 or newer. Restart Desktop before patching another APK.

Tested on Maps `26.42.02.997557324` on an Android 16 phone with the default patches.
